header.name: crucible
header.tagline: Register a thesis, measure each claim, name the weakest axis.

flows.title: How a claim earns its standing, and how it loses it
flows.alt: Eight stages from a registered thesis to a self-contained review packet. Each claim is steelmanned, measured against a substrate, and graded; a round that is not cohesive reflects on the weakest axis and re-measures it. The verdict is a pure function of the measurement and ends as match, drift or unverifiable.
flows.footnote: The verdict recomputes from the stored record, so a confident assertion cannot move it.

stages.title: Thesis
stages.note: A claim set under one seal, each with what would refute it.

stages.title: Steelman
stages.note: The strongest test is proposed before anything is measured.

stages.title: Measure
stages.note: Each claim meets a substrate: a deviation, and its tolerance.

stages.title: Cohesion
stages.note: The harmonic mean of margins, so one weak axis drags it down.

stages.title: Verdict
stages.note: A pure function of deviation and tolerance. No model here.

stages.title: Registry
stages.note: The assessment is stored under a sha256 receipt with the seal.

stages.title: Recheck
stages.note: Rows are re-read from disk and the verdicts recompute.

stages.title: Packet
stages.note: A bundle that carries its own zero-import verifier.

returns.label: NOT COHESIVE: THE WEAKEST AXIS IS RE-MEASURED

outcomes.label: UNVERIFIABLE
outcomes.note: the axis could not be measured at all
